title: Didn’t come with clip
text: Didn’t come with clip. I ordered this for my kitchen. It does what it should do and seems to be durable. The problem I have is it didn’t come with the clip that holds the bag in place. I called to have it replaced and the second one was missing the clip as well. Instead of trying to replace this one I found my own solutions instead of going through anymore trouble. I’ve now have two incomplete trash cans. I do not recommend this company since both the replacement was missing the same piece.

product_metadata.title: HUAPPNIO Kitchen Trash Can Plastic Collapsible Wall Mounted for Cabinet Door Hanging Garbage Bin 2 Gallon (Beige)
features: Features: cabinet door hanging + no-punch wall-mounted + collapsible + trash can lined storage slot + fixed trash bag clipboard.

Cabinet door or drawer hanging collapsible trash can. The trash can comes with hooks, which can be hung on the kitchen cabinet door or drawer. It is convenient for storing garbage without bending down, and is a good helper for storing food waste and office garbage.

No-punch wall-mounted collapsible trash can. Comes with a piece of non-marking sticker, you can put the non-marking sticker on the smooth surface objects such as walls, glass, washing machine, table corner edges, etc., and hang this collapsible trash can. It is a good helper for you to store food waste, table food waste and laundry lint. It is also a good anti-dog trash can when you hang the trash can on a high wall.
Dimensions. Length: 24CM, height: 25.2CM, unfolded width: 16CM, folded width: 6CM.
